purpose: Teach: 鳴き声/獲物/一手/一等/部材/校庭/自販機/大河

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の咳の鳴き声、診断の参考になります。
lines.en: Ren, the way a patient coughs tells us a lot. It helps with the diagnosis.
lines.style: Clear, steady delivery. No rush. Warm professorial tone—sharing knowledge with someone genuinely interested. Light emphasis on 'cough' as a diagnostic tool. Clinical but human.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染源を獲物のように追跡、興味深いです。
lines.en: So you're hunting down the infection source like tracking prey. That's interesting.
lines.style: Quiet enthusiasm. Slight lean forward. Noticing Ren's framing and appreciating it. Half-amused, half-genuine intellectual interest. Not performing—thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。治療の一手目、迅速に。
lines.en: Yes. And the treatment starts right away—no hesitation.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Conviction on 'starts right away.' Steady eye contact. The voice of someone who has seen delays cost time. Direct and grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一等地の医院、地域密着型ですね。
lines.en: Being in a central location like this, you're really embedded in the community.
lines.style: Observation more than question. Thoughtful pause before 'embedded.' Ren testing his understanding. Respectful curiosity—sensing there's something deliberate in her choice of placement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 医療機器の部材、品質管理、徹底しています。
lines.en: Equipment materials, quality control—we don't cut corners on any of it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Quiet pride underneath. Each phrase lands with weight. No need to oversell. Someone who believes standards keep people safe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 校庭周辺の小児医療、需要、ありますか。
lines.en: There's real demand for pediatric care in this area, especially around the schools.
lines.style: Acknowledging the question seriously. Slight warmth—Ren is asking the right things. Natural pace, no hesitation. The answer of someone who has thought about what the neighborhood needs.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。自販機の飲料、子供への糖分問題、注意喚起しています。
lines.en: And the vending machines—the sugar content in what kids drink—we make sure parents are aware of that.
lines.style: Shift to concern, but delivered calmly. Not preachy. A detail she cares about but doesn't dramatize. Steady, almost conversational. The weight is in the care, not the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大河の流域、水質医療連携、別章で扱いますね。
lines.en: The water quality in the river basin and how that connects to health—that's a separate conversation. We'll get to that.
lines.style: Closing thought, reflective. Slight trailing off. Ren is learning she thinks in layers. Gentle, reassuring—there's room for complexity. The voice of someone with depth still untested.
